decisions.reason: The GPIO reassignment controls the separate switched 5V rail and does not change the standalone USB-powered 3.3V supply.
Changing the 5V_EN GPIO does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or DCDC1 power-path requirements.
The interboard connector continues to carry the signal named 5V_EN; changing which MCU GPIO drives that signal does not change its connector designation or pinout.
The complete same-message MODIFY already records 5V_EN as GPIO5, the SCL0 and SPI_MOSI reassignments, and the unexposed module GPIOs.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not affect the battery connector series, mounting style, or unresolved pinout.
The LEDs remain supplied from 5V and still require a logic-level shifter; the source changes only the GPIO assigned to the rail-enable signal.
The complete same-message MODIFY already changes the LED rail-switching control GPIO from GPIO3 to GPIO5.
This Requirement concerns the 3.3V I2C sensor modules and their board interfaces, which are unaffected by reassignment of the switched 5V rail enable.
The source does not change the separate board's eight-LED count, board role, or SK6812 LED-family selection.
The GPIO reassignment has no effect on battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source changes GPIO assignments and makes no component availability, cost, or sourcing decision.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not alter the power board's dimensions, mounting holes, connector placement, or enclosure fit.
